risks: The test reads wording loosely. A future ACT that explains in a separate sentence, without "never" or "not", that removing the locks is harmful would be flagged by mistake. The README asks such an explanation to carry its negation in the same sentence. The opposite slip is also possible: a removal sentence that happens to contain "not" passes, though a removal command would still be caught.
lessons: When a test must fail on a reviewed state, pin the commit the review read (here `0b9deb2d`). The branch head can move to the fix during the work.
